FAQ
Everything you need to know before visiting
Direct answers to the most common questions from pet owners in Mohandiseen.
How much does a vet consultation cost in Mohandiseen?
Consultation pricing at Vet Help Clinic Mohandiseen starts at a mid-range rate relative to the area and includes a complete clinical examination and consultation. For a current quote tailored to your pet, message us on WhatsApp at +20 112 629 1657.
Does Vet Help Clinic offer home visits?
Yes, Vet Help Clinic offers high-quality veterinary home visits across Mohandiseen, Dokki, Agouza, and Zamalek. The team arrives with the necessary equipment to perform exams, vaccinations, and sample collection in the comfort of your home. Book on WhatsApp.
How do I book an appointment at Vet Help Clinic?
You can book three ways: WhatsApp us at +20 112 629 1657, call directly, or visit the clinic at 45 Ahmed Orabi Street, Mohandiseen, beside TotalEnergies Gas Station. We typically reply within minutes during working hours.
Do you treat African Gray parrots and exotic birds in Mohandiseen?
Yes — this is a signature specialty at Vet Help Clinic Mohandiseen. We care for African Grays, cockatiels, parrots, and exotic pets like sugar gliders and hedgehogs. Our doctors are trained in the exam, nutrition, and surgery needs of species that rarely find a specialist nearby.
What are Vet Help Clinic's working hours?
Vet Help Clinic operates daily during an extended evening shift to fit pet owners' schedules. For the current weekly timetable and to confirm before visiting, message us on WhatsApp at +20 112 629 1657.
Is there an exotic bird vet specialist in Cairo?
Yes — Vet Help Clinic in Mohandiseen offers the rare exotic-bird specialty in Cairo. We cover African Grays, cockatiels, sugar gliders, hedgehogs, and rabbits, with full services including exams, nutrition, vaccinations, and surgery.
How much does cat vaccination cost in Mohandiseen?
Cat vaccination pricing at Vet Help Clinic Mohandiseen depends on the vaccine type (tetravalent, trivalent, rabies) and number of doses. We use imported, certified vaccines. For a current quote and the right schedule for your cat's age, WhatsApp us.
Do you offer therapeutic boarding for sick pets?
Yes, Vet Help Clinic offers therapeutic boarding for pets requiring ongoing medical care, alongside general hotel-style boarding. Animals are under the medical team's supervision around the clock, with medication tracking and condition-specific meals.
